Package com.csse3200.game.perks.tortoises

Class TortoiseCarrierAssigner

java.lang.Object
com.csse3200.game.perks.tortoises.TortoiseCarrierAssigner
public final class TortoiseCarrierAssigner extends Object
Turns TortoisePlan into actual carriers when a map is built: picks easy enemies on the map and gives each a TortoiseDropComponent.

Only the easy enemies can carry one (the Skeleton, Ranged Skeleton, Harpy and Ranged Harpy), so a mini boss, an escort or Zeus is never picked. Tortoises whose carrier cannot be found, for example because the enemies on the map were already killed in an earlier visit, are handed back so the caller can place them on the ground instead. That is what stops a total from becoming unreachable when a carrier died before its tortoise was picked up.

The enemies must not have been created yet: Entity.addComponent ignores a component added after creation. If one was, its tortoise is handed back like any other without a carrier.

    • assign

      public static List<String> assign(String mapName, List<Entity> enemies, Random random)
      Gives this map's planned random tortoises to carriers.
      Parameters:
      mapName - the map's name, as in MapData.getName()
      enemies - every enemy built for the map, before any of them is registered
      random - the source of randomness
      Returns:
      the ids of planned tortoises that were not found yet and got no carrier; the caller should place each on the ground. Empty if everything was assigned.
